name: hipcortex-chrome-extension
description: HipCortex Memory — the browser perception layer for a local-first HipCortex runtime. Captures ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Gemini and DeepSeek conversations, and delivers them to a runtime on your own machine: either the HipCortex Desktop app over native messaging, or a server you started yourself on loopback. It reads no site until you grant it that site, it pre-authorises no remote host, and it never discards a capture the runtime has not acknowledged.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
